blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Motorcycle taxi riders’ group Metro has called for a review of rider limits, saying these should be based on passenger demand and not restrict drivers’ livelihoods. Metro co-convener Jayson Luna said the Department of Transportation and the Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB) should introduce long-term reforms that benefit both riders and commuters. “Our longstanding call has been to ensure that no rider loses their livelihood,” Luna said in a statement. “We hope this will lead to better regulations, fairer rider allocation and full legalization of the motorcycle taxi industry,” he added.
